Proactively shape engineering practices, propose improvements, and influence standards adopted by multiple teams.

Advocate for and document best practices in frontend development.

Own and architect systems or product areas end-to-end, designing solutions that scale across multiple teams and business domains.

Build strong cross-functional relationships to ensure smooth collaboration and alignment.

Write clean, modular, and maintainable code that stands the test of time.

Continuously improve and refactor existing codebases for reliability and efficiency.

Take responsibility for production systems through on-call rotations, ensuring stability and fast incident resolution.

Mentor and sponsor engineers at all levels, building future technical leaders and spreading best practices throughout the company.

Anticipate organizational and architectural challenges, define long-term strategies, and drive adoption of solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience across Cint.

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time driving cross-team technical initiatives and architectural decisions.

Highly proficient in Next.js 14+ (App Router), including expertise in data caching strategies and performance optimization.

Demonstrates proficiency in various UI rendering architectures (SSR, CSR, SSG, ISR) and the ability to determine their appropriate application.

A proven expertise in designing and implementing robust UI solutions using TypeScript, with a strong focus on applying comprehensive typing throughout the stack to deliver maintainable and highly reliable user experiences.

Proficiency in breaking down product documents and abstracts into well-defined feature epics and user stories, driving features from concept to reality promptly.

Experience with CSS and Tailwind, and in working with Figma and internal design systems.

Track record of building reliable, performant systems and establishing testing and quality practices adopted across teams.

Demonstrates strong communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Proven ability to define and drive technical standards across multiple teams or product lines, aligning stakeholders and ensuring adoption.

Experience balancing trade-offs between technical debt, speed, and long-term scalability in a way that advances organizational goals.

Join to apply for the Engineer, Managing Principal - Naval Architect role at Institute of Marine Engineering, Science & Technology (IMarEST)

The Managing Principal Engineer (MPE) for Ship and Statutory Department is a strategic position for the ABS Rio de Janeiro Engineering Department. As ABS continues to expand its services and deliverables, this new leadership position is essential to strengthening client engagement, enhancing technical oversight, and streamlining departmental operations.

The Managing Principal Engineer

  • Functions under the direction and oversight of a more senior Department Engineering Manager, in accordance with established policies, procedures and standards, and has full responsibility for directing and monitoring project work within a technical area of a larger engineering department.
  • Leads in their area of specialization and assigns work according to priority.
  • Acts as a technical resource and mentor to principal, senior and entry to mid-level engineers in area of responsibility.
  • Is responsible for day-to-day activities, including the maintenance of the quality, content, consistency and continuity of all technical work performed in an assigned technical unit or area.
What You Will Do:
  • Responsible for the technical verification of tasks related to ship/statutory disciplines and training new engineers in these areas.
  • Assists in the development of short- and long-range business plans and related annual operating and capital expense budgets.
  • Maintains active awareness of business and management developments affecting present and potential customers.
  • Maintains awareness of product and service capabilities of the business. Identifies improvement and developmental needs, takes action to capitalize on prospective market opportunities and makes recommendations for technology or technical tools and manpower skills necessary to implement new and improved products and services.
  • Ensures that assigned engineering positions are adequately staffed with qualified and competent engineering personnel capable of carrying out assigned technical projects in accordance with established policies, procedures and technical standards.
  • Ensures that all ABS Quality System requirements are fulfilled with regard to project work within a technical unit or area.
  • Monitors the delivery and quality of technical services to customer satisfaction.
  • Prepares annual performance appraisals. Evaluates and communicates individual performance appraisal issues with staff members under his/her direct supervision, and recommends compensation adjustments and advancements to senior management.
  • Identifies training needs and determines appropriate training programs for developing the potential of subordinate and engineering staff members.
  • Plans and monitors ABS mandatory, required and other training needs of subordinate staff members.
  • May serve as account manager on technical projects for designated customers and actively promotes the services of ABS to clients.
  • May serve on technical or industry committees and may represent the company as spokesperson at industry conferences or meetings.
What You Will Need:
  • B.S. degree Naval Architecture, Ocean Engineering, or Marine Engineer ; an M.S. is preferred
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services, and their anticipated future work. The knowledge and ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, concerning technical issues to laymen and experts.
  • Technical background on designing and /or reviewing different types of ships.
For those with Hull backgrounds
  • Demonstrated computer literacy in engineering software.
  • Exposed to the Finite Element Method (coursework or supervised research).
For those with Machinery backgrounds
  • B.S. degree in Marine, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering or other related disciplines; an M.S. is preferred.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • Graduate from University and a minimum of 15 years of related industry experience.
  • B.S. degree Naval Architecture, Ocean Engineering, or Marine Engineer ; an M.S. is preferred
  • Experience in the design and review of ship structures for offshore support vessels, tugs, pushers, and barges for rivers, intracoastal, and oceangoing services; Familiarity with large merchant vessels is also considered an asset.
  • Proficiency in conducting intact and damage stability analyses for ships and offshore structures. This includes freeboard calculations and conditions of assignment, verification of loading manuals, operating manuals, and other related documentation.
  • Knowledge of safety arrangements requirements for ships and offshore structures, based on applicable International Conventions and Regulations for an extensive range of ships and floating units, including Brazilian-flagged vessels, including but not limited to Stability, Load Line, Tonnage, SOLAS, MARPOL, IBWMC, MLC, NORMAMs etc

Reporting Relationships: The incumbent reports directly to a Senior Managing Principal Engineer or higher. Direct reports to the incumbent are members of the engineering or technical staff and office support staff of the assigned technical unit or area.

McDermott International, Ltd is hiring the Principal Installation Analysis Engineer. The role involves interpreting internal or external business issues and recommending best practices. The engineer will solve complex Installation Analysis-related problems and work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal Installation Analysis Engineer may lead functional teams or projects and is regarded as a specialist in Installation Analysis. The candidate should have in-depth expertise in Installation Analysis as well as broad knowledge of the Installation Analysis discipline within the Engineering function.

Job Overview

The Principal Installation Analysis Engineer is responsible for interpreting internal or external business issues and recommending best practices. They will be tasked with solving complex Installation Analysis-related problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal Installation Analysis Engineer may be responsible for leading functional teams or projects and is regarded as a specialist in Installation Analysis. Rust Engineering Lead - Linux and Open Source

3 weeks ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Rust Engineering Lead - Linux and Open Source role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring Rust Engineering Leads of all levels of experience to drive the adoption of this exciting language into the full range of Canonical offerings, starting with Ubuntu but also our own projects and open source offerings. We see Rust as an important new language for system level services and capabilities, and a natural evolution path for the sort of software that would traditionally have been written in C or C++. We believe that there is an opportunity to rethink the foundations of future Linux systems with Rust as a central driver of change in everything from the system firmware and embedded software, bootloaders, up through the kernel and input handling, all the way to the desktop.

We also want to ensure that Ubuntu is the very best platform for Rust development, offering easy access to the widest range of tooling and capabilities that support cutting edge open source and enterprise development.

This job posting is our general process for Rust engineers of all levels of seniority, for all relevant teams at Canonical. Apply here if you are an exceptional software engineer who prefers to work in Rust. After the first round of interviews we'll find the best fit product team at Canonical for you to progress your application based on your personal interests.

Canonical has substantial projects in Python, Go, C, C++ and we are starting to invest in Rust. For front-end development we prefer React and Flutter.

Join us in our mission to deliver innovative open-source solutions to individuals and enterprises around the world. We expect the highest engineering standards and strong motivation to get things done well in a fully home-based and distributed environment. These roles require extensive personal experience with Linux - the more different versions of Linux the better!

Location : we have open roles for Rust engineers in every time zone.

What your day will look like

  • Design and implement well-tested and well-documented software in Rust
  • Advocate for Rust adoption in Canonical and upstream projects
  • Identify projects and codebases that could be prioritised for Rust adoption
  • Debug and fix issues encountered by your users
  • Participate in our engineering process through code and architectural reviews
  • Collaborate with community and colleagues on technical specifications
  • Seek improvements to engineering and operations practices
  • In some cases, deploy and operate services developed by the team
  • Contribute to the success of your product through technical advocacy

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • For more senior roles, experience building, deploying, and operating distributed systems and APIs
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Well-organised, self-starting and able to deliver to schedule
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Professional manner interacting with colleagues, partners, and community
  • Experience designing and writing high-quality Rust software on Linux
  • Experience with and passion for Linux at the system level
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice-to-have skills we would value

  • Experience developing for Ubuntu
  • Experience with LXD, MicroK8s, SnapD, IoT, Juju, Ubuntu Core, Ubuntu Pro
  • Performance engineering and security experience

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Banco de Talentos (Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho)
description:
Banco de Talentos (Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho)

Descrição da vaga

Acompanhar e/ou implementar os programas de segurança, proteção e meio ambiente, seguindo ou produzindo os seguintes processos: PPRA, CIPA, CAT, DDS e etc., fiscalizando e acompanhando o uso dos EPI´s, controlando a data de expiração dos equipamentos e materiais, elaborando relatórios fotográficos, além de palestras e integrações de novos funcionários.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Distribuir diariamente aos colaboradores os EPI`s que serão usados, recolhendo aqueles danificados e separando-os, anotando na ficha pessoal de cada colaborador o que foi retirado e qual a data do trâmite, para fins de enviar uma notificação ao Auxiliar Administrativo para posterior compra, cumprimento da legislação e preservação da integridade física do colaborador.
  • Fazer levantamento diário do estoque de todo o material de segurança do trabalho (entradas e saídas), anotando em planilha manual a relação dos materiais que faltam, repassando ao Administrativo, para fins de reposição de estoque.
  • Visitar diariamente as áreas operacionais, para fins de inspecionar a segurança nas áreas.
  • Fazer vistoria de veículos mensalmente, verificando pessoalmente os freios, faróis e etc., informando aos Terceirizados caso haja necessidade de algum reparo, lançando em planilha feita no Word os problemas relacionados ao veículo e enviando ao Gerente de Filial os problemas encontrados, para fins de manter os veículos em boas condições e segurança dos colaboradores.
  • Fazer análise de risco baseando-se nas atividades que serão feitas pelas equipes, definindo qual será o EPI usado, qual o processo mais seguro para a realização da atividade, enumerando os possíveis riscos, para fins de preservar a integridade física dos colaboradores.
  • Fazer diariamente a inspeção de segurança, especificando as não conformidades existentes nos locais, fazendo um relatório e encaminhando ao Gerente de Filial ou à empresa responsável, para fins de preservar a integridade física do colaborador e do Meio Ambiente.
  • Responsável por elaborar todo trâmite relacionado à eleição da CIPA e os documentos da mesma, exigidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, para fins de atender a fiscalização trabalhista.
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente.
  • Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunindo as CATS, análise de levantamento de acidentes, fazendo um parâmetro e calculando as horas perdidas, total de cada setor, enviando as cópias ao Gerente de Filial e a empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e as horas perdidas.
  • Notificar eventualmente, através de comunicado feito em planilha Excel, uma análise do acidente ocorrido através de simulações ou depoimentos, traçando medidas corretivas, enviando ao Supervisor de área em que ocorreu o acidente, para fins de prevenir acidentes com a mesma proporção.
  • Preencher eventualmente no site do INSS, uma CAT no prazo máximo de quarenta e oito horas após o acidente, informando a lesão ocorrida, o local e a hora, o agente causador, a situação causadora, imprimindo uma cópia e arquivando, fornecendo cópia ao colaborador, e enviando através do site do INSS, para fins de comunicar ao INSS, preservar o colaborador de possíveis dificuldades trabalhistas e a empresa de possíveis processos trabalhistas.
  • Coordenar eventualmente a troca ou efetiva recarga de extintores, inspecionando um a um, mantendo contato direto com a empresa responsável pela manutenção dos extintores para fins da Triunfo estar preparada caso ocorra algum incêndio.
  • Promover eventualmente a integração dos novos colaboradores, apresentando os riscos a que estão expostos, ensinando os procedimentos e análises de riscos, fazendo um treinamento total dos mesmos, apresentação através de Power Point, dando palestras em sala de reuniões, apresentando-os aos seus Supervisores, para fins de mostrar os riscos aos novos colaboradores, apresentar-lhes as responsabilidades e obrigações dentro da empresa.
  • Elaborar mensalmente no Word, gerando cópias e distribuindo em locais de livre acesso aos colaboradores um jornal interno, imputando informações preventivas e atualidades, para fins de fornecer informações e gerar uma integração.
  • Fiscalizar diariamente as Unidades, com o intuito de assegurar que o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança) está sendo cumprido, arquivando e assinando o DDS, para fins de promover a conscientização e prevenção de acidentes entre os colaboradores.
  • Preencher eventualmente uma planilha enviada pelo Porto de Itaguaí, constando a entrada e saída de resíduos da oficina, entregando ao Chefe de Oficina, que é responsável pelo recolhimento, para fins de conformidades junto à FEEMA.
  • Representar eventualmente a empresa na CPATP (Comissão de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalhadores Portuários), participando de reuniões ordinárias e semestrais para fins de justificar problemas e tomar as devidas providências.
  • Planejar, coordenar, orientar tecnicamente, avaliar e realizar estudos, avaliações e inspeções das condições de trabalho, quanto aos aspectos de higiene industrial, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, em áreas, equipamentos, instalações.
  • Elaborar documentação necessária para a abertura da Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho e encaminhar para o Setor de Recursos Humanos para que a mesma seja emitida.
  • Orientar os membros da CIPA para os assuntos ligados a saúde e higiene, através da participação em reuniões e da realização de palestras na semana de prevenção da empresa, visando prevenir doenças e acidentes do trabalho.
  • Indicar e orientar a implementação de medidas preventivas de segurança em toda área industrial, administrativa e proteção ao meio ambiente.
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente.
  • Fazer plano de ação para cumprimento do Anexo SMS escopo do Contrato, apresentando evidências para PETROBRAS.
  • Participar de programas de auditorias de SMS, segurança industrial e de meio ambiente, acompanhar as atividades operacionais nas áreas contratuais, visando à segurança do profissional envolvido, bem patrimonial e meio ambiente.
  • Investigar e analisar acidentes e ocorrências anormais, planejando e executando Plano de Ação trazendo segurança nas operações.
  • Elaborar planos de contingência e coordenar atividades de controle de emergências para todas as áreas contratuais, proceder de acordo com os padrões técnicos e normas operacionais.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação técnica em Segurança do Trabalho
  • Registro no MTE
  • Conhecimento em legislação de segurança do trabalho e normas regulamentadoras (NR)
  • Bons conhecimentos em informática e ferramentas de gestão
  • Habilidade de comunicação e interação com equipes

Benefícios

  • Convênio Farmácia: desconto em medicamentos e produtos diversos para higiene pessoal
  • Alimentação no local
  • GymPass / Seguro de Vida

title: Senior Manager, Legal Counsel FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Reporting to FWWC2027 Head of Event Legal, and working alongside the FIFA Legal team in Zurich, the Senior Manager, Legal Counselis responsible for the provision of legal support in connection with the organization and staging of FWWC27.

This key position plays an integral part in ensuring the successful organization and staging of FWWC27. The successful candidate will be expected to pick up the responsibilities of the role and deliver results from the outset, working in a collaborative and constructive way across all functional areas connected to the delivery of FWWC27.

The role of Senior Legal Counsel for FWWC27 will be based in the Tournament HQ in Rio de Janeiro and is a full time role, but the term of employment is limited in length and will cease at the end of the FWWC27 once any necessary post-tournament requirements are fulfilled.

Key responsibilities

  • Providing legal support to FIFA27 in connection with the organization and staging of FWWC27 across a broad range of legal areas, working alongside the FIFA Legal team in Miami.
  • Planning, setting up and implementing, in collaboration with the FIFA Legal team and FIFA Finance, the tax and corporate structure of FIFA27.
  • Assisting with all corporate, company secretarial and governance matters in respect of FIFA27, including legal, regulatory and FIFA institutional requirements and best practices.
  • Ensuring that the operation of FIFA27 and the staging and organization of FWWC27 complies with all applicable laws and regulations, including all federal, state and municipal laws and regulations.
  • Delivering all necessary legal advice, strategic direction and support during the operational phase, tournament time and wind-down phase of the FWWC27.
Advising, alongside the FIFA Legal team in Miami, on the implementation of the legal framework for the hosting and staging of FWWC27, including:
  • Advising on the implementation of the hosting documentation provided during the bidding process for FWWC27, including hosting agreements, host city agreements, stadium agreements, training site agreements, airport agreements, accommodation agreements and related contractual documentation;
  • Supervising the implementation of the guarantees provided by Brazilian government during the bidding process for FWWC27 across topics such as taxation, immigration, employment and customs; and
  • Supporting the Head of Legal and senior management in its discussions with the Brazilian government and CBF and on the establishment of a FWWC27 event law.
Additional specific areas of responsibility include:
  • Drafting and negotiating service provider agreements and any other contracts to be entered into by FIFA27 in connection with the organization and staging of FWWC27;
  • Managing any contentious matters and disputes that may arise in connection with FWWC27;
  • Advising FIFA and FIFA27 on employment and labour law matters, including drafting employment and human resources contracts, documentation and policies and dealing with employment and labour law disputes;
  • Managing external counsel; and
  • Supporting brand protection and anti-ambush marketing activities as part of the overall brand protection plan developed by FIFA.
  • Coordinating and working closely with other legal divisions within FIFA in relation to the hosting and staging of FWWC27, including in relation to media rights, TV production, content, music, technology, intellectual property, brand protection, sponsorship, marketing, corporate and institutional matters.

Your profile

  • An experienced and skilled lawyer qualified in Brazil with at least 10+ years of experience either in a top firm, large corporate or sporting organization, with experience advising major multinational organizations on a wide range of legal issues.
  • Experience with Administrative and Regulatory Law, Contractual and Civil Law consultancy, Compliance and Data Protection is desirable.
  • Previous experience of legal experience in the sports industry is desirable, particularly experience with the hosting and staging of major sports events. Candidates with a demonstratable interest in the sports industry and a strong commercial legal background will also be considered.
  • Experience recruiting and managing a team.
  • Keen understanding of the various interests and demands of all key stakeholders of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 and a thorough appreciation of how the actions of FIFA27 could affect those interests.
  • Ability to create, develop and maintain strong and reliable relationships with FIFA Senior Management as well as external legal and commercial counterparts.
  • Strong IT skills, including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Capacity to advise the business when making key decisions through critical problem-solving skills and an ability to use sound judgement.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit, motivational leadership, effective negotiation skills, excellent communication skills and positive relationship-management skills.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • A team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and or multinational organization.
  • Qualified as an attorney in Brazil
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology. WHY JOIN US? At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers. We convert audience attention into action through data, machine learning, and continuous optimization. We’re hiring a Machine Learning Engineer (Recommendation Systems) to build the personalization engine behind our portfolio of brands. You’ll design, deploy, and scale ML systems that power real-time recommendations across millions of user journeys. This role gives you the chance to work on systems serving 100M+ predictions daily, directly impacting engagement, retention, and revenue at scale.

MUST HAVE

  • 7+ years building and scaling production ML systems with measurable business impact

YOUR ROLE

Your mission: Drive business growth by building and optimizing the recommendation systems that personalize experience for millions of users daily. You’ll own the modeling, feature engineering, data pipelines, and experimentation that make personalization smarter, faster, and more impactful.

OUTCOMES

  • Build and deploy ML models serving 100M+ predictions per day to personalize user experiences at scale
  • Enhance data processing pipelines (Spark, Beam, Dask) with efficiency and reliability improvements
  • Design ranking algorithms that balance relevance, diversity, and revenue
  • Deliver real-time personalization with latency <50ms across key product surfaces
  • Run statistically rigorous A/B tests to measure true business impact

  • Partner with product, engineering, and analytics to launch high-impact personalization features
  • Implement monitoring systems and maintain clear ownership for model reliability

COMPETENCIES

  • Technical Mastery: You know ML architecture, deployment, and tradeoffs inside out

  • Impact-Driven: You design models that move revenue, retention, or engagement
  • Collaborative: You thrive working with engineers, PMs, and analysts to scope features
  • Analytical Thinking: You break down data trends and design rigorous test methodologies
  • Ownership Mentality: You own your models post-deployment and continuously improve them
  • Execution-Oriented: You deliver production-grade systems quickly without sacrificing rigor
  • Curious & Innovative: You stay on top of ML advances and apply them to personalization

description:
Overview

Função Analista de Infraestrutura atuará na configuração, operação e monitoramento de redes corporativas (LAN, WAN, WLAN) com foco em alta disponibilidade, desempenho e segurança. Garantir a segurança da informação em todas as camadas da infraestrutura, incluindo firewalls, VPNs, proxies, NAC, IDS/IPS, WAF e demais mecanismos de proteção. Conduzir análises de vulnerabilidades, propor e implementar ações corretivas/preventivas em ambientes críticos.

Quais serão suas responsabilidades?
  • Atuar no planejamento, configuração, operação e monitoramento de redes corporativas (LAN, WAN, WLAN) com foco em alta disponibilidade, desempenho e segurança.

  • Produzir documentação técnica de infraestrutura, segurança e relatórios executivos com status das ações.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para os demais analistas da área.
O que esperamos que você possua?
  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência na área;
  • Inglês Intermediário;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em redes de computadores;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em redes layer 2 (vlan, trunk, spanning-tree, port-channel, vpc);
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em redes layer 3 (rota estática, ospf, bgp e vrf);
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em ACL/prefix-list e route-map;
  • Conhecimentos de segurança de redes (regras de permissão, vpn, ids/ips);
  • Conhecimento em firewall Fortinet e Palo Alto;
  • Conhecimento em automação/programação (python);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoração (zabbix);
  • Conhecimento em análise de logs e troubleshooting;
  • Conhecimento em multicast (pim, rp);
  • Conhecimento em redes sem fio (Wi-Fi);
  • Capacidade de planejamento e execução de projetos e demandas de forma independente;
Qualificação Academica e Certificados:
  • Certificação CCNP ou similar;
  • Ensino superior em engenharia, ciência da computação, sistemas de informação, redes de computadores, análise de sistemas e afins;
  • Certificação Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer (PCNSE);
  • Certificação Fortinet Certified Professional (FCP) (substitui o antigo NSE 5);
  • Certificação Fortinet Certified Solution Specialist (FCSS) (Substitui o antigo NSE 6 e NSE7)
Como você pode se destacar?
  • Inglês;
  • Habilitação para dirigir, quando necessário para deslocamentos;

  • Provide support to LATAM in any finance or accounting matter.
  • Support on reviewing all Financial Statements.
  • Ensure all SOX requirements are met (including Brazil).

  • Knowledge of IFRS
  • Direct and indirect taxes of service companies (calculation, tax returns, etx)
  • Strong attention to detail and a willingness to learn.
  • Thorough knowledge of business Portuguese, including grammar, spelling, and punctuation.

  • Good knowledge of MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to work independently with limited supervision.
  • Ability and willingness to learn new tasks and software as required.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with supervisors, coworkers, and business professionals.
  • Dynamic, proactive (contributing ideas to enhance all relevant systems and processes), initiative, contributing well in cross-functional teams, open-minded for changes, accountability
  • Self-organized, committed to meet business needs and timelines, able to work flexibly where required and willing to learn
  • Mature self-awareness, confident to liaise with colleagues at other group entities and outside own department and country as required.

  • SAP experience

  • Capability to project a positive and considerate image to external parties and coworkers.
  • Languages requirements: Portuguese (native), English (spoken and written proficiency); knowledge of Spanish is a plus.

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production in offshore oil and gas. True. Blue. Responsibilities
  • You support Machinery Engineers and the Maintenance Team in managing the Condition-Based Program for rotating equipment on SBM FPSOs, including compressors, turbines, blowers, pumps, gearboxes, and motors;
  • You review and monitor rotating equipment conditions using vibration data, lube oil results, and other critical operating data (e.g., pressures, temperatures, flows, loads, efficiencies) to assess equipment health;
  • Manage the Vibration & Oil Analysis Database and support the issuance of recommendations, consolidating inputs from third parties for the Offshore crew;
  • You are responsible for Input actions in the Computerized Maintenance Management System;
  • You should Follow-up on recommendations execution and effectiveness;
  • You perform continuous vibration analysis on equipment with installed Machinery Monitoring Systems (e.g., Bently Nevada System 1).
  • You set up pre-warnings and alerts to proactively identify potential issues and necessary actions;
  • You collaborate with Operations and Maintenance Personnel, Technical Support Team, and Region Planners to prioritize repairs for identified equipment deficiencies;
  • You assist in troubleshooting by analyzing vibration data and other key machine parameters;
  • You provide vibration and oil analysis history to support root cause analysis efforts.
  • You offer guidance to the Technical Support Team and System Leads on machinery conditions during task risk assessments and gate reviews (e.g., after major repairs or life extension evaluations);
  • You identify and justify the purchase of major predictive equipment spare parts;
  • You provide technical assistance for root cause analysis related to ICSS failures and recommend remedial actions.

  • Experience with Rotating machinery;

  • Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken;
  • Ability to manage several activities in parallel, combined with flexibility and strong organization;
  • Ability to travel internationally (short term), including offshore.

Descrição da vaga

Cargo: Engenheiro(a) de Integridade Naval – Casco Externo. Garantir a integridade naval por meio do planejamento e execução de inspeções e reparos baseados em risco, gestão de UWILD, amarras, mangotes e hawser, interação com Classe/Bandeira, assegurando conformidade, segurança e eficiência operacional. Promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e motivador, estimulando o engajamento e a colaboração dos colegas de trabalho e da equipe. Atuar com foco em segurança operacional, excelência técnica e cultura de prevenção, garantindo que as atividades sejam realizadas com responsabilidade, eficiência e respeito à vida.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Planejar e executar o programa de integridade naval, priorizando por risco (RBI), analisando relatórios de classe, UWILD, mooring, definindo escopos e workpacks de inspeção e reparo; manter dashboard e registro de anomalias.
  • Conduzir campanhas UWILD, preparando escopo, selecionando métodos (GVI/CVI por ROV, END focal e leituras de CP), minimizando mergulho, para cumprir requisitos e evidências de Classe para UWILD.
  • Gerir mangotes de offloading e hawser, implementando rotina de inspeção, recertificação, critérios de aceitação e descarte, controle de sobressalentes e definir planos de execução.
  • Assegurar integridade de amarras do sistema de ancoragem, aplicando gestão de integridade ao longo do ciclo de vida, incluindo inspeção, avaliação de desgaste e tensão, plano de substituição.
  • Interagir com Classe/Bandeira, atendendo inspeções, respondendo findings, comprovando correções e mantendo dossiês técnicos para auditorias e vistorias.
  • Coordenar SIMOPS e logística de inspeções, planejando janelas, alinhando AHTS/apoio, e privilegiar soluções “no dive” sempre que possível.
  • Padronizar normas e procedimentos internos, redigindo e atualizando procedimentos para casco, amarras e offloading; treinar equipes e garantir aderência.
  • Gerir terceiros e QA/QC, qualificando fornecedores, conduzindo kick offs, supervisionando execução, validando relatórios com evidências e KPIs e promovendo a execução com total segurança.
  • Documentar e medir desempenho, mantendo o SAP e repositório técnico atualizados com planos, certificados, relatórios, e registros de anomalias; reportar KPIs de integridade e conformidade.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação completa em Engenharia Naval, Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas correlatas. Registro ativo no CREA. Pós-graduação ou MBA em Engenharia de Confiabilidade, Gestão de Ativos, Projetos ou áreas afins será considerado um diferencial.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos Específicos: Sólido conhecimento em normas técnicas e regulatórias aplicáveis à integridade de ativos offshore, API, ASME, DNV, ABS e normas da Marinha do Brasil. Domínio de metodologias de inspeção baseadas em risco (RBI), análise de falhas (RCFA), gestão de anomalias e planos de inspeção e teste (ITP).
  • Ferramentas e Sistemas: Experiência avançada com SAP PM para gestão de manutenção e inspeções, ferramentas de análise de dados como Excel avançado e Power BI, além de softwares de engenharia e modelagem estrutural (ex: AutoPIPE, ANSYS, OrcaFlex). Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de projetos (MS Project, Primavera) e sistemas de controle de MOCs e não conformidades.
  • Certificações e Treinamentos Regulatórios: Treinamentos obrigatórios para atuação offshore (CBSP, HUET, NR-10, NR-35, entre outros) devem estar atualizados conforme exigência legal.
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado para leitura e fala, interpretação de normas técnicas internacionais, elaboração de relatórios e comunicação com entidades certificadoras e fornecedores.

title: Ai Engineer (Senior/Lead) Id40978
description:
Overview

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI / ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

Why Join Us

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Senior AI Engineer to join our elite consulting team. You\'ll work on diverse internal R&D initiatives and high-stakes client projects, delivering production-ready AI systems that solve real business problems. This role combines deep technical expertise with client-facing responsibilities. You\'ll architect solutions, lead implementation, and present to C-level executives and technical stakeholders.

What You Will Do
  • Design and implement end-to-end AI solutions for clients across various industries and use cases;
  • Build sophisticated LLM applications using RAG, vector databases, fine-tuning, and agentic workflows;
  • Develop custom ML models for client-specific challenges including NLP, computer vision, and predictive analytics;
  • Independently assess, clean, and engineer features from complex, messy datasets;
  • Own the complete data pipeline from ingestion through model training and deployment;
  • Lead technical discovery sessions and solution architecture discussions with client stakeholders;
  • Present technical concepts and project outcomes to executive leadership and technical teams;
  • Mentor junior engineers and establish AI / ML best practices across client engagements;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, and business stakeholders;
  • Contribute to internal R&D initiatives and thought leadership in AI / ML.
Must Haves
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience with strong fundamentals;
  • 5+ years deploying production machine learning systems at scale;
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with LLMs, including API integration and local deployment;
  • Strong data engineering and data science expertise—you can work with raw, unstructured data and transform it into ML-ready datasets;
  • Proficiency with data manipulation tools : pandas, NumPy, SQL, and big data frameworks (Spark, Dask);
  • Expert-level Python proficiency with deep knowledge of ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face);
  • Proven experience with modern AI techniques : RAG, vector search, prompt engineering, and agentic systems;
  • Strong cloud platform expertise (AWS, GCP, Azure) with containerization and orchestration experience;
  • Experience building scalable microservices, APIs, and ML inference pipelines;
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and manage complex projects end-to-end with minimal oversight;
  • Exceptional communication skills with experience presenting to senior leadership;
  • Consulting mindset with ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions;
  • Track record of leading technical projects from conception to production deployment;
  • Upper-Intermediate English level.
Nice to Haves
  • Previous consulting or client-facing engineering experience;
  • Experience across multiple industries (fintech, healthcare, e-commerce, etc.);
  • Advanced statistical analysis and experimentation design experience;
  • Experience with streaming data platforms and real-time ML systems;
  • Contributions to open-source AI / ML projects or technical publications;
  • Experience with MLOps, model monitoring, and deployment automation;
  • Background in data engineering and large-scale data processing;
  • Advanced degrees in Computer Science, AI / ML, or related technical fields;
  • Startup or fast-paced environment experience.
Perks and Benefits
  • Professional growth : Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation : We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • A selection of exciting projects : Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
  • Flextime : Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

Looking for Data Analysts at junior, mid, and senior levels to join a fully remote, 100% remote project for an engagement expected to run through November, with a potential for extension depending on project needs. At emagine Portugal, we believe in the power of talent to drive transformation. As a global consulting company, we connect top professionals with high-impact projects across Europe. With a strong presence in Portugal, we are focused on delivering value through innovation, collaboration, and agility.

What We Offer
  • 100% remote work with flexible schedules.

Remote Talent Data Analyst

Ontem

Recognized as the leading software development company in the Americas, our client offers 100% remote modality and an excellent work environment where employees can thrive, and work in multicultural teams, with flexible schedules and endless growth opportunities.

- Understanding of top-of-the-line Data Analysis tools. Previous experience with administration, licensing, security, and deployment is a plus.

- Advanced English level.

- Diverse and multicultural work environment.

A Movida é uma empresa de soluções inovadoras em mobilidade urbana e modelo de negócios com forte direcionamento para desenvolvimento socioambiental. Desde 2006 no mercado, conta hoje com a frota mais nova do Brasil e dispõe de lojas nas principais cidades e aeroportos do país. A companhia é reconhecida como uma locadora moderna, alinhada às últimas tendências tecnológicas e que investe em diversificação e renovação de frota, treinamento de funcionários e serviços exclusivos.

Norteada pela devoção em servir, foi pioneira em oferecer serviços como aluguel mensal e de longo prazo para pessoa física, opções para pré-pagamento e diárias de 27 horas. Focada em tecnologia, também saiu na frente do setor ao oferecer soluções como web check-in, wi-fi no carro, chatbot nas redes sociais e tecnologia de pagamento contactless em todos os veículos.

Empresa da SIMPAR, hoje faz parte da Movida Participações, criada em 2015 para administrar as operações de Aluguel de Carros, Venda de Seminovos e de Gestão de Terceirização de Frotas de veículos leves.

A Movida se diferencia pelo seu "jeitão" inovador e descomplicado. Carrega em seu DNA o foco no cliente e a sua GENTE como prioridade!

Todos os processos seletivos conduzidos pelaMOVIDA são afirmativos,inclusivos e não discriminatórios.

  • Acompanhamento e realização de tratativas referente a todos os veículos em manutenção. (Contato com fornecedores, recebimento de orçamentos, lançamento em sistema, contato com condutores e gestores para informar status).
  • Acompanhamento e monitoramento das infrações de trânsito cometidas pelos condutores (Extração de relatórios no portal de multas, envio de links ao cliente, atualização de e-mails atrelados as placas da frota.
  • Liberação de veículos reservas.
  • Controle e solicitação de documentos aos condutores que tiverem envolvimento de sinistros e acidentes de trânsito.
  • Contato com condutores terceiros, para explicação dos procedimentos internos da Movida e atualização de status.
  • Contato direto com as áreas internas responsáveis nas tratativas solicitadas pelo cliente.
  • Recebimento de medições de locação e extras, para análise e repasse ao cliente.
  • Experiência com rotinas administrativas e múltiplas demandas
  • Experiência com gestão de frotas é um diferencial
  • Conhecimento básico em manutenção de veículos é um diferencial.

A Movida (MOVI3) é uma empresa de aluguel de carros que oferece soluções inovadoras em mobilidade urbana para todo tipo de necessidade. Pioneira em oferecer serviços como aluguel mensal para pessoa física, Wi-Fi no carro, pré-pagamento e ChatBot nas redes sociais, foi a primeira locadora do país a ir além do carro, ajudando a revolucionar o setor de locação no Brasil. Antenada aos novos tempos, investe em sustentabilidade, sendo a primeira locadora de veículos no mundo, listada em bolsa, a receber a Certificação de Empresa B, fazendo parte de um seleto grupo de companhias que têm como modelo de negócios o desenvolvimento socioambiental. No Brasil, foi a primeira a ter um programa como o Carbon Free, que neutraliza as emissões de CO2 das locações dos seus clientes.

Desde 2006 no mercado, a Movida foi adquirida em 2013 pela JSL, abriu capital em fevereiro de 2017 e hoje é uma das empresas da SIMPAR S.A. title: Coordenador(a) de Suporte Técnico – PRIO – Rio de Janeiro
description:
Cargo: Coordenador(a) de Suporte Técnico

Descrição da vaga

Missão do cargo: Coordenar a equipe responsável por prover apoio técnico às unidades de produção, com equipe especializada, promovendo segurança e eficiência das operações. Promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e motivador, estimulando o engajamento da equipe e o desenvolvimento contínuo dos profissionais. Atuar com foco em segurança operacional, excelência técnica e cultura de prevenção, garantindo que as atividades sejam realizadas com responsabilidade, eficiência e respeito à vida.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Coordenar o suporte técnico de segundo nível para equipamentos dinâmicos, sistemas elétricos, automação e instrumentação, realizando diagnósticos e troubleshooting em falhas complexas, embarcando esporadicamente para atendimento emergencial offshore e mantendo contato próximo com operações para alinhamento técnico contínuo.
  • Planejar e acompanhar ações corretivas e alternativas técnicas para falhas funcionais, atuando junto às equipes onshore e offshore, propondo soluções técnicas viáveis e apoiando na elaboração de planos de ação e priorização de recursos.
  • Atender chamados técnicos via Flow e Greendocs, analisando criticidade e urgência dos chamados, direcionando para resolução técnica adequada, registrando histórico e ações tomadas.
  • Participar de projetos nas fases FEL-1, contribuindo com estimativas de custo e escopo técnico no EVTE e validando viabilidade de execução e integração com sistemas existentes.
  • Representar tecnicamente a área em situações críticas e emergenciais, participando de salas de guerra e interdições, elaborando respostas técnicas para órgãos reguladores e coordenando ações imediatas com stakeholders internos e externos.
  • Gerenciar tecnicamente contratos e fornecedores, desenvolvendo memoriais descritivos (MD), acompanhando entregas pontuais e conformidade técnica, avaliando desempenho e propondo melhorias.
  • Elaborar e revisar TBE (Technical Bid Evaluation) de grandes equipamentos, definindo critérios técnicos de avaliação, comparando propostas de fornecedores, recomendando alternativas mais adequadas ao escopo do projeto.
  • Avaliar e implantar recomendações de segurança e mudanças técnicas, participando da gestão de mudanças, propondo execução de melhorias, garantindo conformidade com normas e diretrizes de segurança.
  • Manter a governança técnica de sistemas de dados offshore, gerenciando o PI System e demais sistemas de monitoramento, garantindo integridade e disponibilidade das informações, promovendo uso eficiente dos dados para tomada de decisão.
  • Gerenciar a governança de turbomáquinas, monitorando desempenho e confiabilidade operacional, garantindo disponibilidade dos ativos críticos, desenvolvendo padrões técnicos e estratégias de manutenção mais eficazes, propondo ações de melhoria, garantindo suporte técnico especializado.
  • Gerenciar OT (Operational Technology), avaliando redes industriais e obsolescência, implementando medidas de segurança cibernética, garantindo integridade dos sistemas de automação.
  • Assegurar a integridade e conformidade legal dos sistemas de rádio e telecomunicações, realizando o licenciamento junto à ANATEL e CINDACTA, conduzindo inspeções de abrangência de sinal VHF/UHF e antenas, executando inspeções de abrangência sonora do sistema PAGA.
Requisitos e qualificações

Formação acadêmica (graduação se necessário ou curso técnico): Ensino superior completo em Engenharia (preferencialmente Mecânica, Elétrica, Automação ou áreas correlatas). Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas técnicas ou de gestão será considerado um diferencial.

Experiência prévia desejada e/ou mandatória :

  • Diagnóstico e troubleshooting de falhas complexas em:
  • Equipamentos dinâmicos (ex.: turbomáquinas)
  • Sistemas elétricos, automação e instrumentação
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de monitoramento como PI System.
  • Familiaridade com redes industriais e tecnologia operacional (OT)
  • Gestão de contratos técnicos e fornecedores
  • Elaboração e análise de TBE (Technical Bid Evaluation)
  • Licenciamento e conformidade legal de sistemas de rádio e telecomunicações (ANATEL, CINDACTA)
  • Normas e diretrizes de segurança operacional
  • Inglês avançado
